optimization_rules.condition: Observed CPA exceeds 20.00 USD by more than 20%.
optimization_rules.recommended_action: Pause the weakest ad cell, move budget to the best-performing audience, and keep the campaign in draft-review mode before any live mutation.
optimization_rules.rationale: CPA is the primary efficiency guardrail for conversion growth.
